FLOWER_GENERATOR_12 }} A '''Flower Minion''' is a {{Skill|Foraging}} [[Minions|Minion]] that plants and collects various {{Item|Flower}}s. A '''Flower Minion I''' can be bought from the {{Zone|Dark Auction}} for a minimum of {{C|2.5m}}. '''Flower Minion''' recipes, except '''Flower Minion XII''', are unlocked by default. '''Flower Minion XII''' recipe is unlocked after reaching [[Museum/Milestones|Museum Milestone 10]]. {{Item|Flowers}} planted by a '''Flower Minion''' are a {{Item|Dandelion}}, a {{Item|Poppy}}, or a randomly selected flower (excluding {{Item|Dandelion}}s, {{Item|Poppy|text=Poppies}}, and {{Item|Sunflower}}s). A '''Flower Minion''' equipped with {{Item|Thorny Vines}} plants and collects {{Item|Wild Rose}}s. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Flower Minion|ideal=Grass}} ==== Special Layouts ==== A '''Flower Minion''' can be made to not spawn 2 block tall flowers by placing a roof of any non-air block above the minion's spawning area. This does not affect the rate of {{Item|Dandelion}}s and {{Item|Poppy|text=Poppies}}. A '''Flower Minion''' can be made almost twice as fast by letting water break the flowers and push them into {{Item|Hopper}}s. To let the '''Flower Minion''' have time to plant flowers, the water needs to be on a timer which can be created with a {{Item|Cobblestone Minion}} and a cobblestone generator. Through a series of water pipes, the water from the timer can be spread to all '''Flower Minions'''. This will cause the minion to skip the harvesting action, but that does make the minion {{Red|10%}} slower{{ConfirmationNeeded|is every planting action made slower?}}. On top of that, the water can linger for too long, blocking the minion, so it is almost twice as fast.{{InfoNeeded|Tutorial on building this layout}} Special layouts only work when the {{Zone|Private Island}} is loaded. === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|foraging}} === Quests === A '''Flower Minion''' is required on step 9 of the [[Romero and Juliette]] quest. Any tier works and it will not be returned. == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Tips == * All flowers can be sold to NPC for {{c|1}}. However flowers that are {{Green|2}} blocks high can be turned into 2 of their specific dyes, which sells for {{c|2}} total. == Trivia == * '''Flower Minion''' recipes can be viewed in-game using /viewrecipe FLOWER_GENERATOR_2, even if the player doesn't have the minion unlocked. * A '''Flower Minion''' has the largest amount of possible drops at {{Green|13}} different items. * '''Flower Minion''' is the only [[Minion]] type to have every storage slot unlocked upon obtaining. * '''Flower Minion''' is the only [[Minion]] type to not be upgraded to tier XII via a purchase in an [[NPC]] shop. * A '''Flower Minion''' is the only item in a [[Dark Auction]] guaranteed to appear. * When surrounded by [[Dirt]], [[Podzol]] and [[Coarse Dirt]] a '''Flower Minion''' does not complain. It will also not produce flowers. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 5|'''Flower Minions''' can produce {{Item|Wild Rose}} with a {{Item|Thorny Vines}} applied.}} |beta= {{History|2019/Jul 2|[[File:Flower Minion Render.png|26px]] Added Tier I–XI '''Flower Minion'''.}} {{History|2019/Oct 11|Increased '''Flower Minion''' time per action by approximately {{Green|50%}} per level.}} {{History|2021/Nov 2|Added Tier XII '''Flower Minion'''.}} {{History|2023/Oct 24|Fixed '''Flower Minions''' being affected by {{Item|Rabbit Pet}} rather than {{Item|Ocelot Pet}}.}} {{History|2025/Nov 29|link=none|'''Flower Minions''' no longer produce {{Item|Sunflower}}s.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|'''Flower Minions''' can produce {{Item|Wild Rose}} with a {{Item|Thorny Vines}} applied.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Minions}} {{Nav/Dark Auction}} [[Category:Dark Auction]]
